On 5th April 2008 I visited New York, U.S.A. to attend a meeting. The costs were partly met by Titanic Quarter. On 5th October 2008 I visited the Lebanon to give a lecture. The costs were met by the Westminster Foundation. From 3rd October 2009 to 7th October 2009 I visited Romainia to participate in a charity house build project. The costs were met by Habitat for Humanity.
